name: [Spellbook 1174-2404-6678] Infinite mana lands you control can produce, Infinite green mana, Infinite landfall triggers, Phase out any number of creatures any number of times

other: Notable prerequisites: You control at least five creatures.

Spellbook description: Activate Gaea's Cradle by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}{G}{G}.
Activate Talon Gates of Madara's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Oboro Breezecaller by paying {2} and returning Talon Gates of Madara from the battlefield to your hand, untapping Gaea's Cradle.
Activate Talon Gates of Madara's third ability by paying {4}, putting it from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Talon Gates of Madara enters the battlefield, it triggers, phasing out up to one target creature.
Repeat any number of times.

MANA-ACCOUNTING CHECK (this agent, 2026-08-12, not yet cross-checked in an executable engine): per loop cycle, income = Cradle (G per creature you control, call it N) + Talon Gates' first ability ({C}) = N+1 total mana. Expense = Oboro Breezecaller activation ({2}) + replaying Talon Gates from hand ({4}) = 6 generic. Net = (N+1)-6 = N-5. At N=5 (Spellbook's stated threshold) net = 0: the loop is mana-neutral - it sustains itself and gives genuinely unlimited landfall triggers and phase-out activations for free, but does NOT accumulate a growing mana surplus. Strictly 'infinite green mana'/'infinite mana lands can produce' in the bank-arbitrary-amount sense requires N>5, i.e. at least 6 creatures you control, one more than Spellbook's stated prerequisite. Caveats on this check: (1) assumes Talon Gates' phase-out ETB targets nothing or an opponent's creature - if it phases out one of your own creatures, N drops and the loop goes net-negative even sooner; (2) not yet verified whether Oboro Breezecaller itself and/or a land-based creature would be double-counted or excluded from N; (3) this is exactly the kind of discrepancy Phase 3 / Level 4 validation exists to resolve definitively, ideally by reproducing the line in Forge or XMage (both confirmed to have all three cards implemented, see coverage_backlog INFRA-0002) rather than trusting either this calculation or Spellbook's prerequisite text alone.

result.summary: Infinite mana lands you control can produce, Infinite green mana, Infinite landfall triggers, Phase out any number of creatures any number of times
